rows.ethical_framing: # gunnchOS3k MLV Hackathons **Public landing page and knowledge base** for planned **Summer 2026** community hack days in Northwest Indiana — starting with the **Merrillville pilot Hack Day**. > **You do not need a thousand-dollar laptop to participate.** If you have a phone, curiosity, and willingness to learn, you can join, build, have fun, and compete. ---

**gunnchOS3k MLV** is a Northwest Indiana-rooted technology education and innovation organization. We make computing, AI, games, and emerging technology accessible through **beginner-friendly, phone-first** hackathons where students, professionals, and curious community members can learn, collaborate, and build projects they are proud to show. This repository hosts: 1. A **static website** in [`/docs`](docs/index.htm

After you enable GitHub Pages, the site will be available at: **`https://gunnchOS3k.github.io/gunnchOS3k-MLV-Hackathons/`** *(Enable Pages: Repository **Settings → Pages → Build from branch → `/docs` folder → Save.)* Until Pages is enabled, preview locally (below). ---

gunnchOS3k-MLV-Hackathons/ ├── docs/ # Static website (GitHub Pages root) │ ├── index.html # Main landing page │ ├── styles.css │ ├── script.js │ └── assets/ # Logo and images ├── resources/ # Knowledge base (markdown) │ ├── README.md │ ├── what-is-a-hackathon.md │ ├── participant-outcomes.md │ ├── phone-first-toolkit.md │ ├── project-submission-guide.md │ ├── parents-and-guardians.md │ ├── volunteer-guide.md │ ├── s

No install required: 1. Clone this repository 2. Open **`docs/index.html`** in your web browser (double-click or File → Open) For a simple local server (optional): cd docs python3 -m http.server 8080 # Visit http://localhost:8080 ---
